annotations.title: Get a link to pay a balance, an extension or a deposit

description: Get a link to pay a balance, an extension or a deposit. Needs `payments:write`. Answers a link for the person to open on DJfindr, signed in as themselves; the act happens only there. Give them the url as it is and do not open it or pass it to anyone. Asking again replaces the link given before. get_link says whether it was used.
name: get_pay_link
title: Get a link to pay a balance, an extension or a deposit
